strong.boogeymans_exam:
Title: The Boogeyman's Exam
Duration: 60 seconds
0-8s: Moro the monster must scare Noah with his scary roar to pass his exam, but Noah refuses to be scared.
8-18s: Moro fails again when Noah laughs at the scary roar.
18-28s: Moro shares a blanket with Noah and they become friends.
28-38s: Noah trembles in a storm. Moro can now scare Noah and pass his exam.
38-46s: Moro deliberately drops the exam badge and rejects the chance to scare Noah, choosing to shield Noah instead.
46-52s: Moro uses the same scary roar to protect Noah from the storm.
52-56s: Moro officially fails the exam and loses his badge.
56-60s: Noah calls Moro Best Monster and welcomes him into the family.
strong.predator_protector:
Title: The Flock
Duration: 60 seconds
0-8s: Wolf wants to infiltrate the flock and steal food using his predator strength, but the lambs question him. Wolf secretly disguises himself as a sheep.
8-18s: Wolf fails to reach the food while the lambs follow him.
18-28s: Wolf shares a meal with a lamb and begins to trust the flock.
28-38s: Wolf can now steal food from the sleeping lambs and escape.
38-46s: Wolf deliberately rejects the chance to steal food and steps in front of the lambs to defend them from intruders.
46-52s: Wolf uses his predator strength to protect the lambs.
52-56s: Wolf gives up the food and loses his chance to escape.
56-60s: The wolf becomes their protector and the flock welcomes him as a member.
strong.thief_guard:
Title: The Key
Duration: 60 seconds
0-8s: Tess the thief wants to steal the gate key for a reward using thief-thinking, but a guard blocks her way. Tess pretends to help the guard.
8-18s: Tess fails to pick the guarded lock.
18-28s: Tess shares bread with the guard and they become friends.
28-38s: Tess can now steal the gate key while the guard sleeps.
38-46s: Tess deliberately drops the key and rejects the theft to guard the sleeping friend instead.
46-52s: Tess uses the same thief-thinking to catch another thief.
52-56s: Tess loses her reward for the key.
56-60s: Tess becomes the guard and is welcomed as a friend.

weak.garden_guardian:
Title: Garden Guardian
Duration: 60 seconds
0-8s: Arda looks scary in a costume but is actually harmless.
8-15s: A friend misunderstands Arda, and birds flee from his scary costume.
15-25s: Arda runs around the garden.
25-35s: Arda chases birds along a fence.
35-45s: Arda jumps, looks behind him and waves his arms.
45-55s: Arda repeats the chase.
55-60s: The same scary costume scares birds away and saves the garden.
weak.nice_all_along:
Title: A Friendly Face
Duration: 60 seconds
0-10s: Arda looks scary but is actually nice all along.
10-20s: A friend misunderstands him.
20-35s: Arda walks around the room.
35-50s: The friend looks at Arda again.
50-60s: Arda smiles and the friend sees he was always harmless.
weak.action_without_choice:
Title: The Race
Duration: 60 seconds
0-10s: Pip wants to win a reward, but a gate blocks him.
10-20s: Pip runs, jumps and chases a cart.
20-30s: Pip climbs, pulls and pushes a box.
30-40s: Pip runs, jumps and chases another cart.
40-50s: Pip climbs, pulls and pushes again.
50-60s: Pip accidentally knocks the gate open and wins the reward.
weak.unrelated_twist:
Title: The Surprise
Duration: 60 seconds
0-10s: Pip wants to steal food using his speed, but a locked door stops him.
10-25s: Pip fails to reach the shelf.
25-40s: Pip runs around the room and hides under a chair.
40-50s: Pip tries the same door again.
50-60s: A new genie arrives and gives Pip a flying spaceship.
